name: Narus Story
source:
Narus Story is a short visual novel demo for the main game FWMML (Flee with me my love.) Flee with me my love is about two girls. One of the girls, Yuna Makasi who lives in planet earth and the other one, Jasha Mbeka who lives in the planet Maho no Sekai.
The people in Maho no Sekai have the ability to use the power of magic. Because of an accident the human Yuna is stranded in Maho no Sekai and has to fight alongside the watermagician Jasha Mbeka and her friends to get back to the human world.
This Visual Novel is a flashback of Naru Takeru a Magician who mastered the magic of water.
He is the best friend of Jasha Mbeka who is the granddaughter of the strongest magician.
Because of her weak magic she is not allowed to leave her village and people make fun of her.
Naru takes care of Jasha, since her grandfather, who is his master, left for a mission and hasn’t been seen since.

[From [url=https://patla.itch.io/narus-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Narus Story》是主游戏FWMML（逃离我的爱人）的简短视觉小说演示。《逃离我的爱人》讲述了两个女孩的故事。其中一名女孩是生活在地球上的尤娜·马卡西，另一名是生活在魔王世界上的贾莎·姆贝卡。
魔方世界的人们拥有使用魔法力量的能力。由于一次意外，人类尤娜被困在魔法世界，必须与水魔法师贾莎·姆贝卡和她的朋友们一起战斗才能返回人类世界。
这部视觉小说是掌握水魔法的魔术师鸣武的闪回。
他是最强魔法师的孙女贾莎·姆贝卡最好的朋友。
由于她的魔法很弱，她不被允​​许离开她的村庄，人们嘲笑她。
纳鲁负责照顾贾莎，因为她的祖父（也就是他的主人）去执行任务后就再也没有出现过。

[来自[url=https://patla.itch.io/narus-story]Itch.io[/url]]
